pages.title: Forest of Magic
pages.text: Towering blue firs and giant mushrooms shut out the sky; Ghost Fire, Dream and Demonic Miasma mushrooms grow wild, and a miasma that makes the weak fills the trees. Who could settle down here?

pages.title: Ghost Fire Mushrooms
pages.text: The mushrooms that light the forest floor. Every cap gives off a faint glow of its own, so a patch of them reads like a row of lanterns strung under the canopy, and a mature ghost fire stands taller than a person on a slender stem.

pages.title: Dream Mushrooms
pages.text: The tallest and roundest of the three, and entirely lightless. Dream mushrooms give off no glow whatsoever, so a dream grove stays dim even at midday — which is how you learn to recognise one from a distance.

pages.title: Demonic Miasma Mushrooms
pages.text: The least conspicuous of the three breathes out a heavy miasma, which billows beneath the cap and then creeps along the forest floor. Standing in it is never a good idea — living things grow weak.

pages.title: Blue Fir
pages.text: A boreal lineage reshaped by a warmer, wetter climate: tall, winding trunks under layers of flat-spread needles, dotted with mushrooms and trailing sparse vines.

pages.title: Eugune and Vines
pages.text: Eugune bracket fungi grow out of the trunks, in three colors; evergreen vines hang from the branches in long strands.

pages.title: Forest Floor
pages.text: Star flowers, tall enough to reach and bright enough to notice; flame cattails growing in and around the ponds; broom grass as common as any weed; bracken threaded through it all. The floor of the Magical Forest looks like an untended herbalist's storehouse.
